items.difficulty_reason: The proposition proves that there is a unique rule assigning to every scheme of the category a total Chern class on the Grothendieck group of vector bundles valued in the cohomology ring, additive for sums, compatible with pullbacks and normalized on invertible modules (statement lines 4124-4139). The proof (proof lines 4140-4283) constructs the Chern classes through projective bundles, verifies centrality and pullback compatibility, proves multiplicativity in short exact sequences by induction on the rank, descends to the Grothendieck group, and proves uniqueness. H3: a long construction with an induction and a uniqueness argument, written out in full.
